question.en: Why do people think the writer is mad?
question.zh: 为什么人们认为作者疯了？

sentences.en: Why do people think the writer is mad?
sentences.zh: 为什么人们认为作者疯了？

sentences.en: Aeroplanes are slowly driving me mad.
sentences.zh: 飞机正在逐渐把我逼疯。

sentences.en: I live near an airport and passing planes can be heard night and day.
sentences.zh: 我住在一个机场附近，过往飞机日夜不绝于耳。

sentences.en: The airport was built years ago,
but for some reason it could not be used then.
sentences.zh: 但由于某种原因当时未能启用。

sentences.en: Last year, however, it came into use.
sentences.zh: 然而去年机场开始使用了。

sentences.en: Over a hundred people must have been driven away from their homes by the noise.
sentences.zh: 有100多人肯定是被噪音逼得已经弃家远去。

sentences.en: I am one of the few people left.
sentences.zh: 我是少数留下来的人中的一个。

sentences.en: Sometimes I think this house will be knocked down by a passing plane.
sentences.zh: 有时我觉得这房子就要被一架飞过的飞机撞倒。

sentences.en: I have been offered a large sum of money to go away,
sentences.zh: 他们曾向我提供一大笔钱让我搬走，

sentences.en: but I am determined to stay here.
Everybody says I must be mad and they are probably right.
sentences.zh: 大家都说我肯定是疯了，也许他们说的是对的。
